tasks.title: Serve GET …/scm/outline
steps: Add a row for the outline route to the table scmRoutes of internal/scm/helpers_test.go, so that the access, caching, timeout and recorder tests cover it, write the route's own behaviours in a new internal/scm/outline_test.go and, under the build constraint cgo, the table of the fifteen languages in internal/scm/outline_cgo_test.go, and confirm they fail

Declare GET /workspaces/:slug/scm/outline with the component's route helper under the new op outline, and add outline to the values of the label op of parley_scm_requests_total in the metrics catalogue and its test

Read path with the file route's path check and ref with the resolver, the default branch when absent; give the answer its caching headers from the resolved commit before anything of the file is read, so that a current copy costs no read

Look the path up at the commit as the file route does: 404 path_not_found, 400 for a directory or a submodule. A symbolic link is answered 200 with supported false, language "" and no declarations, without reading its target

Refuse a file over 1 MiB with 413 payload_too_large and its size before reading it; read the bytes; refuse a file with a NUL byte in its first 8,000 bytes with 422 binary_file naming the path, using the probe blame uses

Outline the bytes with outline.Outline of github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/outline under the request's context, which ends at the read timeout; an error of a cancelled context is left to the read wrapper, which answers 503 scm_timeout

Answer 200 with path, resolved_sha, language (the outline's Lang), supported (its backend is not none) and declarations: kind, name, container, signature, exported, start_line, end_line, in the outline's order and [] when there are none
Run go mod tidy: the outline package brings the tree-sitter grammar modules into go.mod. Confirm that cmd/parley still builds with CGO_ENABLED=0 and that its dependencies name none of them
Describe the route, its answer, its errors and the op outline in docs/api.md, and the outline in the source control part of docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Build parleyd with cgo in the hub image
steps: Extend the hub image's test in test/image/hub_test.go with the outline of a Python file and the run of the image's parley, and, where a container engine is at hand, confirm it fails; without one, say so in the report: the image tests skip, and the criterion stays unshown

In containers/hub/Dockerfile, build parleyd with CGO_ENABLED=1 in a build stage that holds a C toolchain (build-base on the alpine Go image), and parley in a go build of its own with CGO_ENABLED=0; keep the linker flags and the build arguments of both

Keep the runtime stage on the alpine image the build stage's C library matches, so that parleyd starts without any package added for it; add none unless the binary needs one, and name it in the Dockerfile's comment if it does
Extend the test of test/e2e/build_test.go that builds the binaries: cmd/parleyd builds with cgo, and cmd/parley, as before, with CGO_ENABLED=0

Say in README.md, where it says how to build, that parleyd needs a C toolchain to outline languages other than Go and that parley needs none; describe the image's two builds in the packaging part of docs/architecture.md
